raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

In Qwen3-Next's full-attention layers (every fourth layer), the prologue between `qkv_proj` and attention runs on HIP as split/chunk copies, a GemmaRMSNorm launch for q and one for k, and `rotary_embedding`. On gfx950 the aiter fused prologue (`fused_attention_qk_norm_rope`) is called when the installed aiter provides it; current aiter does not (ROCm/aiter#6835 is open), so the unfused path runs.

## Modifications

- New Triton kernel `kernels/ops/attention/qk_gemma_norm_rope.py`: splits `[q||gate]`, k and v from the gated-attention qkv projection, applies GemmaRMSNorm to q and k per head and neox partial RoPE with the fp32 cos/sin cache, in one launch. It keeps the unfused path's bf16 rounding points (normalized value, cos/sin and each product of the rotation).
- `models/qwen3_next.py`: `Qwen3HybridAttentionDecoderLayer` takes the kernel on gfx95 when the rope is the neox `RotaryEmbedding` on its fallback kernel with an fp32 cache and the head sizes are powers of two. It is not taken under `--rl-on-policy-target`, where RoPE forces its native path to match the trainer bitwise. The aiter fused prologue keeps priority.
- `qkv_proj` is computed once in `self_attention` and passed to the prologue in use, so an aiter prologue that reports a shape as unsupported falls back without running the projection a second time (on main the fallback recomputes it).
- New test `test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_qwen3_next_fused_qk_prologue.py` (`jit-kernel-unit`, AMD) compares the kernel with the native prologue for the per-rank head counts of Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B at TP1/2/4 and 1 to 8192 tokens, plus an empty batch, and checks that `--rl-on-policy-target` keeps the native prologue.

## Accuracy Tests

MI355X (gfx950), image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm10-mi35x-20261025` (torch 2.11.0+rocm10, aiter `285579b6`), `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct-FP8, TP2.

**Kernel output.** v and gate are identical to the native prologue. q and k are identical except where the RMSNorm reduction, summed in a different order than the native GemmaRMSNorm, moves a normalized value to the neighboring bf16 and RoPE carries that difference: over the test shapes and four seeds, at most 7e-5 of the q/k elements differ, by at most 2 bf16 ulp of the rotated pair's magnitude. The test bounds both (1e-3 of the elements, 3 ulp) and requires v and gate to match exactly.

**GSM8K** (`python -m sglang.test.run_eval --eval-name gsm8k --num-examples 1319 --max-tokens 4096`, chat, greedy, 3 runs each, main `1ced9a9eb0`):

| | main | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| Accuracy | 0.9619 / 0.9612 / 0.9589 (mean 0.9607) | 0.9635 / 0.9665 / 0.9627 (mean 0.9642) |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

`python -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang --dataset-name random-ids --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 --random-range-ratio 1.0 --max-concurrency 64 --num-prompts 320`, TP2, main `1ced9a9eb0`, servers in the order main, PR, PR, main on the same GPUs with the node otherwise idle, 4 runs per server with the first dropped:

| | main | This PR | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Output throughput (tok/s) | 6108 | 6226 | +1.9% |
| Median TPOT (ms) | 9.71 | 9.53 | -1.9% |

The two runs of each build agree within 0.4%. Per-layer prologue time (TP2 shapes, 8 q heads and 1 kv head per rank, microbenchmark on main `68e57f4005`):

| Tokens | Native (µs) | This PR (µs) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 9.52 | 1.93 |
| 64 | 13.57 | 2.07 |
| 384 | 17.43 | 3.12 |
| 1024 | 24.68 | 4.86 |
| 8192 | 105.15 | 24.25 |
| 16384 | 200.36 | 76.89 |

With MTP (`--speculative-algorithm NEXTN --speculative-num-steps 5 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6`), same setup on main `62f9f3f785`: median TPOT 6.45 -> 6.29 ms (-2.4%; the two runs of each build agree within 0.5%) and accept length 4.72 -> 4.70. Output throughput went 5762 -> 5888 tok/s (+2.2%), but the two main runs differ by 4% (5885 and 5640), so that change is within the spread.

A torch-profiler kernel census of 30 eager decode steps (batch 8) shows `_qk_gemma_norm_rope_kernel` 360 times (12 full-attention layers x 30 steps) on this PR, replacing `_gemma_rmsnorm_kernel` (750 -> 30), the copy kernels (749 -> 29) and `rotary_embedding_kernel` (360 -> 0).


## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,123 @@
+"""Split q/gate/k from a gated-attention qkv projection, Gemma-RMSNorm q and k
+per head and apply neox partial RoPE, in one launch.
+
+Keeps the unfused path's bf16 rounding points (chunk/reshape copies, GemmaRMSNorm
+on q and k, then rotary_embedding with an fp32 cos/sin cache): v and gate are
+identical, and q/k differ only where the RMSNorm reduction order moves a value to
+the neighboring bf16 (a few in 1e5 elements, at most a couple of ulps).
+"""
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _qk_gemma_norm_rope_kernel(
+    qkv_ptr,
+    pos_ptr,
+    cos_sin_ptr,
+    qw_ptr,
+    kw_ptr,
+    q_out_ptr,
+    gate_out_ptr,
+    k_out_ptr,
+    stride_qkv,
+    stride_cs,
+    eps,
+    NUM_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_KV_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    HEAD_DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    ROT_DIM: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    tok = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    h = tl.program_id(1)
+    HALF: tl.constexpr = ROT_DIM // 2
+    offs_r = tl.arange(0, HALF)
+    offs_d = tl.arange(0, HEAD_DIM)
+    if h < NUM_HEADS:
+        # q_gate is laid out per head as [q (HEAD_DIM), gate (HEAD_DIM)]
+        src = qkv_ptr + tok * stride_qkv + h * 2 * HEAD_DIM
+        g = tl.load(src + HEAD_DIM + offs_d)
+        tl.store(gate_out_ptr + (tok * NUM_HEADS + h) * HEAD_DIM + offs_d, g)
+        w_ptr = qw_ptr
+        dst = q_out_ptr + (tok * NUM_HEADS + h) * HEAD_DIM
+    else:
+        kh = h - NUM_HEADS
+        src = qkv_ptr + tok * stride_qkv + NUM_HEADS * 2 * HEAD_DIM + kh * HEAD_DIM
+        w_ptr = kw_ptr
+        dst = k_out_ptr + (tok * NUM_KV_HEADS + kh) * HEAD_DIM
+
+    x = tl.load(src + offs_d).to(tl.float32)
+    x1 = tl.load(src + offs_r).to(tl.float32)
+    x2 = tl.load(src + HALF + offs_r).to(tl.float32)
+    var = tl.sum(x * x, axis=0) / HEAD_DIM
+    rstd = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(var + eps)
+    out_ty = q_out_ptr.dtype.element_ty
+    y1 = (
+        (x1 * rstd * (1.0 + tl.load(w_ptr + offs_r).to(tl.float32)))
+        .to(out_ty)
+        .to(tl.float32)
+    )
+    y2 = (
+        (x2 * rstd * (1.0 + tl.load(w_ptr + HALF + offs_r).to(tl.float32)))
+        .to(out_ty)
+        .to(tl.float32)
+    )
+    y = x * rstd * (1.0 + tl.load(w_ptr + offs_d).to(tl.float32))
+
+    pos = tl.load(pos_ptr + tok).to(tl.int64)
+    # rotary_embedding does this math in the activation dtype: cos/sin and
+    # each product are rounded before the add
+    cos = tl.load(cos_sin_ptr + pos * stride_cs + offs_r).to(out_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    sin = (
+        tl.load(cos_sin_ptr + pos * stride_cs + HALF + offs_r).to(out_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    )
+    o1 = (y1 * cos).to(out_ty).to(tl.float32) - (y2 * sin).to(out_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    o2 = (y2 * cos).to(out_ty).to(tl.float32) + (y1 * sin).to(out_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(dst + offs_r, o1.to(out_ty))
+    tl.store(dst + HALF + offs_r, o2.to(out_ty))
+    tl.store(dst + offs_d, y.to(out_ty), mask=offs_d >= ROT_DIM)
+
+
+def qk_gemma_norm_rope(
+    qkv: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    q_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    k_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    num_heads: int,
+    num_kv_heads: int,
+    head_dim: int,
+    rotary_dim: int,
+):
+    """qkv: [T, num_heads * 2 * head_dim + 2 * num_kv_heads * head_dim] with q/gate
+    interleaved per head. Returns q [T, H*D], k [T, Hkv*D], v (a view into qkv)
+    and gate [T, H*D]."""
+    T = qkv.shape[0]
+    q = torch.empty(T, num_heads * head_dim, dtype=qkv.dtype, device=qkv.device)
+    gate = torch.empty_like(q)
+    k = torch.empty(T, num_kv_heads * head_dim, dtype=qkv.dtype, device=qkv.device)
+    kv_off = num_heads * 2 * head_dim
+    v = qkv[:, kv_off + num_kv_heads * head_dim : kv_off + 2 * num_kv_heads * head_dim]
+    if T > 0:
+        _qk_gemma_norm_rope_kernel[(T, num_heads + num_kv_heads)](
+            qkv,
+            positions,
+            cos_sin_cache,
+            q_weight,
+            k_weight,
+            q,
+            gate,
+            k,
+            qkv.stride(0),
+            cos_sin_cache.stride(0),
+            eps,
+            NUM_HEADS=num_heads,
+            NUM_KV_HEADS=num_kv_heads,
+            HEAD_DIM=head_dim,
+            ROT_DIM=rotary_dim,
+            num_warps=1,
+        )
+    return q, k, v, gate

@@ -9,6 +9,7 @@
 
 from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.fla.fused_norm_gate import FusedRMSNormGated
 from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.fla.layernorm_gated import RMSNorm as RMSNormGated
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.qk_gemma_norm_rope import qk_gemma_norm_rope
 from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.triton_gdn_fused_proj import (
     fused_qkvzba_split_reshape_cat,
 )

 from sglang.srt.layers.radix_linear_attention import RadixLinearAttention
-from sglang.srt.layers.rotary_embedding import get_rope
+from sglang.srt.layers.rotary_embedding import RotaryEmbedding, get_rope
 from sglang.srt.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import (
     ParallelLMHead,
     VocabParallelEmbedding,
@@ -82,8 +83,10 @@
 _is_cpu = is_cpu()
 _use_aiter = get_bool_env_var("SGLANG_USE_AITER") and _is_hip
 # The fused attention prologue is a gfx950-only aiter op; gate the arch here so
-# other HIP devices never take the fused path (and never pay a double qkv_proj).
+# other HIP devices never take the fused path.
 _use_fused_prologue = _use_aiter and is_gfx95_supported()
+# The Triton prologue (qk_gemma_norm_rope) is validated on gfx950 only.
+_use_triton_prologue = _is_hip and is_gfx95_supported()
 _is_amx_available = cpu_has_amx_support()
 
 
@@ -106,6 +109,27 @@ def _fused_attention_prologue():
     return fused_attention_qk_norm_rope, fused_attention_qk_norm_rope_supported
 
 
+def _supports_triton_prologue(
+    *, rope: nn.Module, head_dim: int, attn_output_gate: bool
+) -> bool:
+    # The Triton prologue follows the native split + GemmaRMSNorm + neox RoPE
+    # (fallback kernel, fp32 cos/sin cache) rounding; it needs power-of-two
+    # head_dim and rotary_dim / 2.
+    return (
+        _use_triton_prologue
+        and attn_output_gate
+        and type(rope) is RotaryEmbedding
+        and rope.use_fallback_kernel
+        # RL on-policy forces the native RoPE to match the trainer bitwise.
+        and not rope._force_native
+        and rope.is_neox_style
+        and rope.cos_sin_cache.dtype == torch.float32
+        and rope.rotary_dim % 2 == 0
+        and (rope.rotary_dim // 2) & (rope.rotary_dim // 2 - 1) == 0
+        and head_dim & (head_dim - 1) == 0
+    )
+
+
 if _is_npu:
     from sgl_kernel_npu.fla.utils import (
         fused_qkvzba_split_reshape_cat as fused_qkvzba_split_reshape_cat_npu,
@@ -741,6 +765,11 @@ def __init__(
         )
 
         self.alt_stream = alt_stream
+        self.use_triton_prologue = _supports_triton_prologue(
+            rope=self.rotary_emb,
+            head_dim=self.head_dim,
+            attn_output_gate=self.attn_output_gate,
+        )
 
     def _apply_qk_norm(
         self, q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor
@@ -764,15 +793,14 @@ def _apply_qk_norm(
         k = k_by_head.view(k.shape)
         return q, k
 
-    def forward_prepare_fused(self, positions, hidden_states):
+    def forward_prepare_fused(self, positions, qkv):
         # gfx950 single-launch prologue: [Q||gate] split + Q/K GemmaRMSNorm +
         # partial RoPE. Returns None when unavailable or unsupported so the
         # caller falls back to the native prologue.
         ops = _fused_attention_prologue()
         if ops is None:

+import unittest
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.layernorm import GemmaRMSNorm
+from sglang.srt.layers.rotary_embedding import RotaryEmbedding, get_rope
+from sglang.srt.models.qwen3_next import (
+    Qwen3HybridAttentionDecoderLayer,
+    _supports_triton_prologue,
+)
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs, set_global_server_args_for_scheduler
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_hip
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=30, stage="jit-kernel-unit", runner_config="amd")
+
+HEAD_DIM = 256
+# Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B: 16 q heads, 2 kv heads; per-rank widths at TP1/TP2/TP4.
+HEADS_PER_RANK = [(16, 2), (8, 1), (4, 1)]
+NUM_TOKENS = [1, 7, 64, 384, 8192]
+# The RMSNorm reduction sums in a different order than the native GemmaRMSNorm,
+# so a rare normalized value rounds to the neighboring bf16 and RoPE carries the
+# difference: measured on MI355X, at most 7e-5 of q/k elements differ, by at most
+# 2 bf16 ulp of the rotated pair's magnitude. v and gate are plain copies.
+MAX_MISMATCH = 1e-3
+MAX_PAIR_ULPS = 3
+
+
+def _bf16_ulp(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    _, exp = torch.frexp(x.float().abs().clamp_min(2.0**-126))
+    return torch.ldexp(torch.ones_like(exp, dtype=torch.float32), exp - 8)
+
+
+def _rope_scale(x: torch.Tensor, num_heads: int, rotary_dim: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    # Per element magnitude bound: the norm of the rotated pair, or the value
+    # itself on the pass-through lanes.
+    x = x.float().reshape(x.shape[0], num_heads, HEAD_DIM)
+    half = rotary_dim // 2
+    pair = torch.hypot(x[..., :half], x[..., half:rotary_dim])
+    scale = torch.cat([pair, pair, x[..., rotary_dim:].abs()], dim=-1)
+    return scale.reshape(x.shape[0], -1)
+
+
+def _make_layer(num_heads: int, num_kv_heads: int) -> Qwen3HybridAttentionDecoderLayer:
+    layer = Qwen3HybridAttentionDecoderLayer.__new__(Qwen3HybridAttentionDecoderLayer)
+    nn.Module.__init__(layer)
+    layer.num_heads = num_heads
+    layer.num_kv_heads = num_kv_heads
+    layer.head_dim = HEAD_DIM
+    layer.q_size = num_heads * HEAD_DIM
+    layer.kv_size = num_kv_heads * HEAD_DIM
+    layer.attn_output_gate = True
+    layer.alt_stream = None
+    layer.rotary_emb = get_rope(
+        head_size=HEAD_DIM,
+        rotary_dim=HEAD_DIM,
+        max_position=32768,
+        base=10000000,
+        partial_rotary_factor=0.25,
+        is_neox_style=True,
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+    ).cuda()
+    layer.q_norm = GemmaRMSNorm(HEAD_DIM, eps=1e-6).to("cuda", torch.bfloat16)
+    layer.k_norm = GemmaRMSNorm(HEAD_DIM, eps=1e-6).to("cuda", torch.bfloat16)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        layer.q_norm.weight.normal_(0, 0.5)
+        layer.k_norm.weight.normal_(0, 0.5)
+    return layer
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available() and is_hip(), "ROCm only")
+class TestQwen3NextFusedQKPrologue(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        set_global_server_args_for_scheduler(ServerArgs(model_path="dummy"))
+
+    def test_matches_native(self):
+        for num_heads, num_kv_heads in HEADS_PER_RANK:
+            layer = _make_layer(num_heads, num_kv_heads)
+            if not layer.rotary_emb.use_fallback_kernel:
+                self.skipTest("the Triton prologue mirrors the fallback rotary kernel")
+            width = layer.q_size * 2 + layer.kv_size * 2
+            for num_tokens in NUM_TOKENS:
+                with self.subTest(heads=num_heads, kv_heads=num_kv_heads, T=num_tokens):
+                    torch.manual_seed(num_tokens)
+                    qkv = torch.randn(
+                        num_tokens, width, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+                    )
+                    positions = torch.randint(0, 32768, (num_tokens,), device="cuda")
+                    q, k, v, gate = layer.forward_prepare_triton(positions, qkv)
+                    q_ref, k_ref, v_ref, gate_ref = layer.forward_prepare_native(
+                        positions, qkv.clone()
+                    )
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(v, v_ref, atol=0, rtol=0)
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(gate, gate_ref, atol=0, rtol=0)
+                    rotary_dim = layer.rotary_emb.rotary_dim
+                    for name, out, ref, heads in (
+                        ("q", q, q_ref, num_heads),
+                        ("k", k, k_ref, num_kv_heads),
+                    ):
+                        self.assertEqual(out.shape, ref.shape, name)
+                        mismatch = (out != ref).float().mean().item()
+                        self.assertLessEqual(mismatch, MAX_MISMATCH, name)
+                        diff = (out.float() - ref.float()).abs()
+                        ulps = diff / _bf16_ulp(_rope_scale(ref, heads, rotary_dim))
+                        self.assertLessEqual(ulps.max().item(), MAX_PAIR_ULPS, name)
+
+    def test_empty_batch(self):
+        num_heads, num_kv_heads = HEADS_PER_RANK[1]
+        layer = _make_layer(num_heads, num_kv_heads)
+        qkv = torch.empty(
+            0, layer.q_size * 2 + layer.kv_size * 2, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        positions = torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda")
+        q, k, v, gate = layer.forward_prepare_triton(positions, qkv)
+        self.assertEqual(q.shape, (0, layer.q_size))
+        self.assertEqual(k.shape, (0, layer.kv_size))
+        self.assertEqual(v.shape, (0, layer.kv_size))
+        self.assertEqual(gate.shape, (0, layer.q_size))
+
+    def test_rl_on_policy_keeps_native_prologue(self):
+        """With --rl-on-policy-target, RoPE runs its native path to match the
+        trainer bitwise; the Triton prologue must not replace it."""
+
+        def make_rope():
+            # Built directly: get_rope caches modules across server args. The
+            # cuda device context matches how the model loader builds it.
+            with torch.device("cuda"):
+                return RotaryEmbedding(
+                    head_size=HEAD_DIM,
+                    rotary_dim=HEAD_DIM // 4,
+                    max_position_embeddings=32768,
+                    base=10000000,
+                    is_neox_style=True,
+                    dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                )
+
+        if not _supports_triton_prologue(
+            rope=make_rope(), head_dim=HEAD_DIM, attn_output_gate=True
+        ):
+            self.skipTest("the Triton prologue is not used on this device")
+        try:
+            set_global_server_args_for_scheduler(
+                ServerArgs(model_path="dummy", rl_on_policy_target="fsdp")
+            )
+            rope = make_rope()
+        finally:
+            set_global_server_args_for_scheduler(ServerArgs(model_path="dummy"))
+        self.assertFalse(
+            _supports_triton_prologue(
+                rope=rope, head_dim=HEAD_DIM, attn_output_gate=True
+            )
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
